positions.title: Front End Lead
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead/Owned the Frontend UI Client for the PetCo Vital Care Premiere experience

- Lead front end implementation of new feature development
- Brought stability reworking a majority of the NextJS React app by implementing and mentoring the team on TypeScript, testing, and other industry best practices.
- Introduced solutions to problems introduced by having an extensible system managed by teams around the globe.
- Quickly responded to new issues closely collaborating with the business team and UX designers
positions.insights: Skills: IT Project Leadership · TypeScript · React.js · Jest · JavaScript · Amazon S3 · Next.js

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Leading an agile team to design, execute, and support complex system solutions.
Managed, interviewed, and contributed to building the team to develop new systems and support existing ones.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Act as a lead developer, taking full responsibility of several code bases, being the point of contact, and guiding other developers through task completion. 
• Work on a high-priority "next-generation" product that will be utilized across the USA, as well as contribute o several original libraries that are open-source. 
• Work and contribute to a custom state machine built on fundamentals of reactive programming utilizing RxJS, React, and TypeScript.
• Obtained government security clearance

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Educate and engage hundreds of students through free bi-weekly lectures and individual tutoring sessions where 4 out of 5 LaunchCode apprentices acquire and find long-term success in a full-time job in tech at no cost to them.
• Contributed curriculum & open-source materials by introducing modern JS concepts.
• Furthered the mission of equal opportunity supporting a class made up of 58% Women, 46% People of Color, and 56% people from low-income households.
• Led transition to remote education successfully maintaining similar retention numbers and even more student satisfaction compared to in-person classes based on surveys.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Provided individualized support to a small group of students over curriculum covering the following: 
• Coding Fundamentals
• JavaScript
• TypeScript 
• HTML
• CSS
• Java 
• Basic Web Authentication
• Problem Solving
• Goal Setting

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Client: ExpressScripts
• Quickly ramped up and provided recommended actions within a window of opportunity at the origin of a new application. 
• Converted the project to TypeScript based on evaluation of the project needs
• Introduced using React-Query to handle async based state.

Client: AbbVie
• Provided a superior solution to the current app direction by providing a more powerful, flexible approach within our business constraints
• Enabled previously impossible UI possibilities by migrating to a React SPA in the cloud.
• Improved maintainability and increased development speed by prioritizing reusability.
• Increased application navigation by 600% by leveraging React, custom REST services and optimization utilizing a cutting-edge state management approach.
• Architected from the ground up in a collaboration with a small dev team.
• Led other devs in best practices, tools and processes, including Agile methodologies.
• Kept the team communicating, organized, efficient, and happy by guiding Agile practices.
• Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, React-Query, RESTful Services, React Testing Library, Fluent UI, React-Router, Microsoft SharePoint (SPFx), SPPnP, WebPack

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description:
Client: Bayer
• Worked on revolutionary agricultural product as indicated by nearly 1 million acres committed in its launch season. 
• All enabled by leveraging cloud-backed data analytics and a cutting-edge mobile application in a fast-paced environment.
• We greatly improved user experience with 100% user adoption within a single week by integrating 10 separate user-management systems into a single unified system.
• Built for long-term scalability and strong security with microservices, micro front-end, and DevOps in mind for a decoupled development and deployment process leveraging AWS and a distributed system.
• Collaborated on an intuitive, beautiful UI by taking designs from the UX team and developing them in an organized, maintainable manner.
• Contributed to superior data management and system design by optimizing performance.
• Cut AWS costs by 50% by properly monitoring and managing unnecessary spending
• Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Redux, React Testing Library, Material UI, RESTful Services, AWS (Fargate, Lambda, RDS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, GitHub, Jenkins)

volunteerExperience.description:
I donate several hours almost every Saturday to help run the food pantry that not only distributes food to those in need, but establishes meaningful relationships to help them gain independence.
I personally interview our visitors to best help evaluate their needs, make a plan, and take action to best help the people. 
We've partnered with many local community gardens to provide local, fresh produce, as well as provide work for the homeless. We try and keep our operation as environment friendly and resource-mindful as possible. We provide many career, health, and relationship counseling as well.
